title: The cycle class of a sheaf flat in high dimensions is a relative cycle
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（22 行证明）、高维平坦凝聚层的循环类是相对循环：假设基变换稳定、specialization 检验降到赋值环、平坦迹开且补集纤维维数低故限制同构、平坦情形由 specialization-module 引理直接收。6 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-family-associated-module-specialization (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1114-1121

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Use stability of the flat-in-high-dimensions hypothesis under base change and compatibility of the cycle-class formation with base change to reduce the specialization check to a valuation ring base, on which the flat locus is open with complement of fibre dimension below r so restriction to it is an isomorphism on r-cycle groups compatible with specializations and with the cycle-class construction, and conclude on the flat locus directly from the valuation-ring specialization lemma for the cycle class of a flat coherent sheaf (source lines 1123-1144)
